title: chore(console): refresh vendored Console SPA to objectui@e6fd254
body:
Bumps the pinned `.objectui-sha` from `6d4cc09` → `e6fd254` (14 upstream commits) and adds a changeset so `@objectstack/console` (and the fixed group) version-bumps on release. CI rebuilds the vendored SPA at publish time.

## Verified locally
- `objectui:refresh` (bump + `build-console.sh`) — console build 32/32 successful, `dist/index.html` produced (~39 MB) from `objectui@e6fd254`.

## Notable upstream changes pulled in
- feat: book metadata display UI + book-driven documentation portal (ADR-0046 §6)
- feat: object fieldGroups as collapsible form sections; full object forms in screen-flow wizard steps
- feat: action progress + Undo affordance; action/flow completion messaging
- feat: CEL on action buttons; i18n for sort/filter builders and view/manage-views menus
- fix: public share link URL + ShareDialog audiences; grouped-view pagination
- fix: docs ToC scrolls in JS so `<base href>` no longer bounces to home

## Release path
Standard changesets two-pass: merge this → CI opens `version packages` PR → merge that → CI builds + publishes to npm.
